name: ambiguous-edit
prompt: In stats.py, the local variable named count inside the tally function should be called matched instead. Rename only that one; every other use of count in the file must be left exactly as it is.
notes: The identifier count appears nine times across three scopes. A model reaching for edit with old_string="count" gets the multiple-match error, and whether it recovers depends entirely on that error naming the line numbers — which is the specific claim edit.go makes. The failure mode is a rename that also hits Window.count and breaks the class.
